'''Casiss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] who was the leader of a [[Nysillin/Legends|Nysillin]] [[Farmer/Legends|farming]] community on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> his village was troubled by [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] under the leadership of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], demanding the farmers' crops, which led him to hire the services of [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and her band of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived in the village, Casiss convinced the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to work with the bounty hunters to finally drive off the pirates. The Jedi trained the villagers to use [[Spear/Legends|spears]] and [[Slingshot/Legends|slingshots]] to defend themselves and they successfully fought back against the pirates, freeing themselves from the fear of future attacks.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Gregory Baldwin]] lent his voice to Casiss, and also voiced [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]] in the "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]" episode. In accordance to the role, as well as the episode's homage, he uses a voice similar to that of the late Mako Iwamatsu.
